title.en: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 Q13: Overlapping Rings
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 第13题：相交圆环

content.en: 7 cards numbered 1 to 7 are in 4 overlapping rings. Each ring sums to 10. Which number is under the question mark?
content.zh: 1–7 的卡片放在 4 个相交圆环中，每环数字和为 10。问号下是哪个数？

explanation.zh: 各环和为 10 可推出问号为 1。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 Q14: Caterpillar Puzzles
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 第14题：毛毛虫拼图

content.en: Lucas makes a caterpillar with a head, a tail and 1, 2 or 3 puzzle pieces between. How many different caterpillars can he make without flipping pieces?
content.zh: 毛毛虫有头有尾，中间 1、2 或 3 片拼图。不翻转时能拼出几条不同的？

explanation.en: Without flipping, exactly 4 different caterpillars are possible.
explanation.zh: 不翻转时恰有 4 种拼法。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 Q15: Flipped Number Cards
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 第15题：翻转后的数字卡

content.en: John writes 1–4 on a sheet, flips it and writes 5–8, then cuts into 4 cards in a row: ? 5 ? 6. What is the sum of the numbers under the question marks?
content.zh: 纸上写 1–4，翻面写 5–8，剪成 4 张排成 ? 5 ? 6。问号数字之和是多少？

explanation.en: Pairs: 1↔7, 2↔6, 3↔8, 4↔5; the ? cards show 1 and 3, sum 4.
explanation.zh: 正反配对后问号为 1 与 3，和为 4。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 Q16: Square Tile Side
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 第16题：正方形瓷砖边长

content.en: A floor uses rectangular tiles 23 cm × 11 cm and square tiles. What is the side-length of the square tiles?
content.zh: 地板有 23 cm × 11 cm 长方形瓷砖和正方形瓷砖。正方形边长是多少？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 Q17: Worm-Eaten Digits
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 第17题：被虫吃掉的数字

content.en: Three cards sum to 782. A worm ate part of each card. What is the sum of the 3 missing digits?
content.zh: 三张卡片数字之和为 782，每张都被虫吃掉一部分。被吃掉的 3 个数字之和是多少？

explanation.en: Missing units digit 5; missing tens digits sum to 6; total missing 11.
explanation.zh: 个位缺 5；十位两缺数之和 6；缺数之和 11。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 Q18: Weighing Blocks
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 第18题：积木称重

content.en: Lucy weighs some blocks on three scales showing 200 g, 100 g and 240 g. How much do the 3 different blocks weigh together?
content.zh: 三台秤分别显示 200 g、100 g、240 g。三种不同积木一共多重？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 Q19: Yellow Vest Orange Pack
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 第19题：黄背心橙书包

content.en: 60 pupils: vests yellow, green, yellow, green…; backpacks red, brown, orange, red, brown, orange… How many have a yellow vest and an orange backpack?
content.zh: 60 名学生：背心黄绿交替；书包红棕橙循环。黄背心且橙书包的有多少人？

explanation.en: LCM of periods 2 and 3 is 6; yellow+orange once per 6 ⇒ 60/6=10.
explanation.zh: 周期 2 与 3 的最小公倍数为 6；每 6 人 1 个黄+橙 ⇒ 10。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 Q20: Hidden Digits Product
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 第20题：图形藏数字

content.en: Same shapes hide the same digits; different shapes hide different digits. What is the value of the product of the three shapes?
content.zh: 相同图形代表相同数字。请问三个图形相乘的值是多少？

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 Q21: Frogs Jump Together
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 第21题：青蛙同时跳

content.en: Exactly 2 frogs in each row and column. Two frogs jump at once to neighbouring empty cells; afterwards still 2 per row/column. In how many ways?
content.zh: 每行每列恰有 2 只青蛙。两只同时跳到相邻空格后仍每行每列 2 只。有几种跳法？

explanation.en: There are exactly 4 valid simultaneous jump pairs.
explanation.zh: 恰有 4 种合法的同时跳跃方式。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 Q22: Honeycomb Honey Count
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 第22题：蜂巢蜂蜜格

content.en: A beehive has 9 cells. Each number shows how many neighbouring cells contain honey. How many cells contain honey?
content.zh: 9 格蜂巢，数字表示相邻含蜜格数。共有多少格含有蜂蜜？

explanation.en: Forced neighbour constraints yield exactly 6 honey cells.
explanation.zh: 由邻格约束可推出恰有 6 格含蜜。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 Q23: Cookie Tray Order
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 第23题：饼干托盘

content.en: Three girls take cookies in some order: all hearts; all white; all large. They take 3, 6 and 7 cookies. Which set does one girl take?
content.zh: 三个女孩分别拿走所有心形、所有白色、所有大块饼干（顺序不定），分别拿 3、6、7 块。哪一组是其中一人拿走的？

explanation.en: Order must be large → hearts → white, taking 7, 6, 3 cookies.
explanation.zh: 顺序为大块→心形→白色，分别 7、6、3 块。

title.en: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 Q24: White and Red Blocks
title.zh: Math Kangaroo 2024 – Level B -2 第24题：白红积木

content.en: A small cube uses 4 white blocks or 1 white + 1 red. The large cube is made of small cubes. What is the smallest number of white blocks needed?
content.zh: 小立方体可用 4 白或 1 白+1 红搭成。大立方体由小立方体组成。最少需要几块白色积木？
